name: care_heart_cohort
title: Adult Patients with Cardiology Encounters (Inpatient or Outpatient) After First Heart Failure Diagnosis
description: This cohort includes cardiology-related inpatient admissions and outpatient visits of patients with heart failure who were 18 years or older at their first heart failure diagnosis. Patients first diagnosed with heart failure before the age of 18 are excluded entirely. An encounter is included when the patient's first heart failure diagnosis occurred on or before the encounter reference time: the discharge date for inpatient admissions and the visit date for outpatient visits.

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

entry.name: patientEncounter
entry.description: Includes inpatient and outpatient hospital encounters associated with cardiology services.

eligibility.name: adultsWithHeartFailure
eligibility.description: Restricts the cohort to patients whose first heart failure diagnosis occurred when they were 18 years or older, and to their encounters whose reference time (discharge date for inpatient encounters, visit date for outpatient encounters) is on or after that first heart failure diagnosis.

criteria.name: adults
criteria.description: Exclude patients who were younger than 18 at their first heart failure diagnosis (patient level: all of their encounters are excluded).

criteria.name: firstHeartFailureDiagnosisBeforeReferenceTime
criteria.description: The patient’s first heart failure diagnosis must occur on or before the encounter reference time: the discharge date for inpatient encounters and the visit date for outpatient encounters.

period.description: Includes all patients for the defined cohort population.
